independent_answer: 320 birds if trees are 3× stones; 400 birds if “three times more” means 4× stones.
check: The solution correctly computes 2 × (3 × 40 + 40) = 320. Interpreting “three times more than” as 300% more gives 2 × (4 × 40 + 40) = 400.
evidence_quote: Number of trees = 3 times the number of stones
error_description: The question’s wording permits two reasonable interpretations. The solution is mathematically correct under the three-times-as-many interpretation.
